description: "Stories About Indians" by Rufus Merrill is a collection of anecdotes and character sketches written in the mid-19th century. This book serves as a glimpse into the lives, customs, and stories of Native Americans, reflecting the author's perspective during a time when Indigenous peoples were often romanticized or misunderstood in American culture.
